verdict.rationale: Navan is a SaaS travel and expense platform. Asking whether it can be self-hosted is fair for this kind of product, since some enterprise SaaS offers on-prem or self-managed deployment. The evidence pack documents only Navan-hosted offerings, including a hosted MCP server and cloud APIs, and gives no self-hosting or on-prem option for the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
